newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: SOCCER-CHINA BEAT BOSNIA 3-0, DEDICATE WIN TO DENG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHINA BEAT BOSNIA 3-0, DEDICATE WIN TO DENG.

text.p: China beat Bosnia 3-0 in the final of the Dunhill Cup on Sunday and dedicated their victory to the nation's late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.
"He was a great lover of football," Chinese team manager Li Chuangi said after watching his side score three second half goals to win the eight-nation tournament.
Li Yunji opened the scoring after 56 minutes and Zhang Xiqorui added a second three minutes later. Hao Haidong sealed China's win with an 81st minute strike.

The Bosnians, missing suspended key players Sanin Puntil and Almir Turkovic, looked jaded throughout the match. Their only consolation was some miraculous goalkeeping by Dedi Mirs which helped keep the score respectable.
